summary: Monroe Capital Enhanced Corporate Lending Fund filed an Item 8.01 8-K disclosing routine fund events: a $0.187 per Class I share cash dividend declared October 20, 2026, payable November 24 to holders of record October 31; a September 30, 2026 NAV of $26.13 per Class I share, $109.9 million total NAV, $107.2 million principal debt and 0.98x debt-to-equity; 38 portfolio companies at $211.5 million fair value (92.9% senior secured, 100% floating-rate debt); and status of its $1.0 billion continuous registered offering. No special-situation transaction is present; no deal terms apply.
